fact: IRRI, ISRA and sarmap piloted satellite-based (Sentinel-1A, Landsat 8/9, Sentinel-2) RIICE rice monitoring in Senegal, mapping 36,300 ha dry-season and 21,200 ha wet-season irrigated rice in the Senegal River Valley; ISRA intends to propose it to the ministry for integration in government information systems.
title: Leveraging Satellite Technology in Senegal's Rice Regions for National Food and Economic Security
